say:2:1521364002:0.text: I've been too scared to take a step forward. I'm a coward... She deserves someone better than that!
say:2:1521364002:0.source_cn: 我这么犹豫，畏畏缩缩不敢上前……这样的人根本没办法给她幸福！
say:2:1521364002:0.male: I've been too scared to take a step forward. I'm a coward... She deserves someone better than that!
say:2:1521364002:0.female: I've been too scared to take a step forward. I'm a coward... She deserves someone better than that!

say:3:1521364003:0.text: It's time to end this... Time for Fufu to forget me completely...
say:3:1521364003:0.source_cn: 是时候结束这一切……让芙彻底忘记我了……
say:3:1521364003:0.male: It's time to end this... Time for Fufu to forget me completely...
say:3:1521364003:0.female: It's time to end this... Time for Fufu to forget me completely...

narration:4:1521364004:0.text: Marco's hands tremble as he writes one last letter. He puts it in your hands.
narration:4:1521364004:0.source_cn: 马尔科颤抖着写下了一封信，交到你手中。

say:5:1521364005:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thank you. You've done so much for Fufu and me...
